sources.sourceTitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

facts.statement: Retrieval-augmented generation first retrieves relevant information from an external knowledge source.
The model uses retrieved context together with the user question to generate an answer.
RAG can improve factual grounding by giving the model relevant source material at answer time.
RAG systems often expose citations or source snippets so users can inspect where an answer came from.
